create_model_subclass: create a subclass of Model that implements predict and feedback abstract methods for CLRS3-B tasks
implement_predict_method: implement the predict method to make predictions about the current task using sampler features
implement_feedback_method: implement the feedback method to advance to the next task incorporating optional feedback data
use_result_type: use the Result type alias as a dict mapping string keys to probing DataPoint values
initialize_model_with_spec: initialize a Model subclass with a single Spec or list of Spec objects for problem setup
